name: verified-survivor-older-dies-first
description: Fixture rules, MFJ: the older spouse (70, higher PIA, claimed early at 66) dies first in 2031; before, the younger gets the spousal excess; after, the survivor benefit (higher of own and the deceased's reduced benefit, 80% PIA floor), a 50% pension continuation, single filing from 2032 (§7.5, §7.7).

capitalMarket.note: Illustrative round-number assumptions chosen by the app authors; not a forecast.
